documentation: This file describes the visual rendering and layout metadata for the FAConLDQ experimental platform. It is intended for reproducibility and documentation on platforms like the Open Science Framework (OSF).

frameworks.name: ShadCN/UI
frameworks.purpose: Component library built on top of Tailwind CSS for UI elements like cards, buttons, and forms.

container.padding: p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 (1rem to 2rem based on screen size)

layout.gridSystem: Tailwind CSS's flexbox and grid utilities are used for component-level layout (e.g., forms, cards).
layout.mainAxis: Vertical, with components stacked within a central card.

spacingAndSizing.scale: Tailwind's default spacing scale is used (e.g., p-4 = 1rem, space-y-6 = 1.5rem).

primary.name: Dark Blue
primary.description: Used for main interactive elements like buttons and icons.

accent.name: Mid Blue
accent.description: Used for hover states and secondary emphasis.

destructive.name: Red
destructive.description: Used for destructive actions like delete buttons.

borderRadius.description: Applied to cards, buttons, and input fields for a modern, soft aesthetic.

shadows.description: Used to elevate primary containers like the main survey card from the background.
